risk_description: The components of the steering system may have been damaged during the assembly process. As a result, the steering power assistance could fail without prior warning or unmotivated steering assistance could limit the steerability of the vehicle, increasing the risk of an accident.
legal_provision: The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
